item.title: Version 1.18
item.description:
What's New in 1.18:

  • Waveform Meter Event Loop Starvation & CPU Elimination: Implemented a Sleep-When-Silent state machine in WaveformMeter that completely suspends canvas invalidations and DisplayLink timer callbacks during silence, reducing idle CPU usage from ~38% down to 0.0%. Wakes up instantly on audio energy and renders fluidly at 24 FPS with full 3x supersampled antialiasing.
  • Silent CoreAudio Tap Desync & Lifecycle Hardening: Prevented tap helper zombie drift by idling the audio capture thread in low power while paused and cleanly terminating the helper. Starting recording now guarantees a fresh tap instance bound directly to the active system audio device within ~40ms.
  • CoreAudio Callback Autorelease Pool: Wrapped the native IOProc block in an autoreleasepool in terpscribe_audio_tap.swift to prevent temporary Objective-C allocations (AVAudioPCMBuffer, NSError) from leaking memory on CoreAudio IO threads during multi-hour sessions.
  • Teardown Deadlock Elimination: Removed synchronous AudioDeviceStop() calls from cleanupAndExit() in terpscribe_audio_tap.swift to prevent self-deadlock when teardown is triggered from inside an active IOProc callback.
  • Dynamic Stream Format & Device Shift Recovery: Added native CoreAudio listeners for kAudioDevicePropertyStreamFormat and dynamic device Object ID changes, instantly rebinding the stream when sample rates or audio layouts shift.
  • Application Teardown Clean Exit: Resolved a NameError: name 'gc' is not defined crash on application shutdown.

item.title: Version 1.17
item.description:
What's New in 1.17:

  • System Audio Tap Desync & Silent Stream Recovery: Added CoreAudio property listeners (kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsRunning, kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsAlive, kAudioHardwarePropertyDevices) to detect and rebind silent stream stalls within 100ms.
  • Resilient Audio Converter & Frame Watchdog: Automatic recovery on sample rate converter errors and consecutive empty frame callbacks.
  • Waveform Meter CPU Elimination & UI Snappiness: Streamlined 3x supersampled rasterization onto a persistent canvas item with cached rendering states and idle throttling, reducing CPU consumption from ~45% down to <1% while preserving pristine Retina antialiasing and particle glow.
  • Manual Tap Refresh: Added click-to-refresh binding on the audio waveform bar.

item.title: Version 1.16
item.description:
What's New in 1.16:

  • Dynamic Audio Output Hot-Plugging: Added native CoreAudio listeners (kAudioHardwarePropertyDefaultOutputDevice, kAudioDevicePropertyDeviceIsAlive, kAudioDevicePropertyNominalSampleRate) to the audio tap helper. When output devices switch mid-session (plugging/unplugging headphones, connecting AirPods, or Zoom re-routing audio), the tap helper cleanly restarts and rebinds to the active device within 100ms, eliminating silent stream freezes.
  • Audio Tap Supervisor Reconnect Latency: Reduced reconnection delay from 300ms to 100ms and added structured lifecycle logging.

item.title: Version 1.15
item.description:
What's New in 1.15:

  • Degraded Audio Acoustic Tagging ([Unclear]): Automatically identifies low-confidence, muffled, or faint speech and displays a distinct [Unclear] badge in the transcript and exports.
  • Linear Phase Audio Tap Downmixing: Replaced phase-switching channel picking in native audio tap with standard linear phase-coherent averaging (0.5 * (L + R)), eliminating phase cancellation and distortion on stereo streams (Zoom, Teams, Meet).
  • Acoustic Confidence Threshold Hardening: Raised candidate decode confidence floor to -0.85, preventing low-certainty acoustic guesswork and silence hallucinations.
  • Cross-Candidate Non-Speech Consistency Guard: Discards alternate language candidates if one candidate outputs silence/filler defaults (e.g. 'Gracias').
  • Language Anchor Grounding & Foreign Script Filter: Requires functional anchor grounding for multi-word phrases and eliminates alien Nordic/Icelandic character leakage.
  • Stutter & Repeating Character Loop Filter: Automatically halts cyclic sub-character loops and hyphenated stutter cascades before they enter transcripts.
  • Adaptive Speech Gain Scaling: Expanded peak normalization ceiling up to 6.0x to bring faint, distant voices into Whisper's optimal phonetic decoding range.

item.title: Version 1.10
item.description:
What's New in 1.10:

  • General Availability & Production Milestone: Official promotion of TerpScribe to the 1.x stable release line for professional conference and legal interpreters.
  • Audio Tap Resilience & CoreAudio Lifecycle: Emitted READY handshake immediately upon successful AudioDeviceStart in terpscribe_audio_tap and guaranteed explicit CoreAudio aggregate device and tap teardown on SIGTERM/exit, eliminating false permission timeouts and leaked coreaudiod resources.
  • IIR Filter NaN Corruption Guard: Implemented NaN/Inf state sanitization in HighPassFilter80Hz to prevent floating-point anomalies from corrupting filter memory into permanent digital silence.
  • Capture Thread Exception Resilience: Wrapped audio_capture_worker in a top-level exception handler to prevent silent thread crashes and ensure continuous background audio recovery.
  • macOS App Nap Disabled: Set NSSupportsAppNap to False in application bundle configuration to ensure high-priority execution and avoid UI timer or meter throttling when TerpScribe is running in the background.

item.title: Version 0.9.49
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.49:

  • Log Directory Permission Guard: Added graceful fallback handling for logging and cache directory initialization to prevent startup crashes on macOS user accounts with restricted folder permissions.

item.title: Version 0.9.48
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.48:

  • Pure Logprob Candidate Scoring: Reduced anchor density score multiplier to 0.01 to prevent translated English stopword inflation from outscoring raw acoustic decoding confidence (avg_logprob).
  • Spanish Subtitle & Credit Hallucination Suppression: Expanded non-speech hallucination filter in audio.py to catch Spanish YouTube subtitle triggers ("suscríbete al canal", "suscribete", "gracias por ver", "subtítulos").
  • Legal Short-List Protection & Dual Acoustic Noise Gate: Added protected short-words whitelist ("sí", "no", "ok", "yo") and required dual acoustic checks (RMS energy + crest factor) before suppressing low-energy background noise.

item.title: Version 0.9.47
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.47:

  • Log-Probability Candidate Scoring & Anti-Translation: Implemented avg_logprob candidate decoder scoring with native anchor density boost to guarantee native transcription over forced translation during language switching in dual-language mode.
  • Decoder Context Drift Prevention: Completely removed initial_prompt from Whisper base decode options to eliminate English prompt context drift during non-English speech recognition.
  • Accented Character Loop Suppression: Expanded suppress_character_loops in engines/normalize.py to cover accented vowel repetitions (e.g. "ÉÉÉÉ" -> "ÉÉÉ").

item.title: Version 0.9.45
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.45:

  • System Prompt Self-Hallucination & Subtitle Suppression: Added prompt self-hallucination guard in engines/whisper.py to wipe out echoed system prompts, expanded NON_SPEECH_HALLUCINATIONS in audio.py to filter stock subtitle credits (provided by microsoft corporation), and added single-character stutter suppression.
  • Universal Translation-Suppression & Quick Reference Isolation: Isolated Quick Reference as a 100% inert UI notepad and enabled dual-pass translation suppression across all engines.

item.title: Version 0.9.44
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.44:

  • Contextual Initial Prompt Framing & Keyword Sanitization: Stripped metadata badges (- CR) from dynamic keywords and wrapped terms in natural sentence context to prevent Whisper prompt hallucination.
  • N-Gram Multi-Word Repetition & Prompt Leak Guards: Added multi-word loop and prompt leakage guards across transcription pipeline.

item.title: Version 0.9.43
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.43:

  • Added character repetition loop suppressor to collapse consecutive letter repetitions (Mmmmmmm...) and drop standalone hesitation tokens.

item.title: Version 0.9.42
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.42:

  • Formatted number entity highlighting includes thousand/decimal separators as part of the yellow tag (e.g. 4,291).
  • Single-click on formatted numbers adds the complete string (e.g. 4,291) directly to Quick Reference.

item.title: Version 0.9.41
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.41:

  • Integrated dedicated public model repository asset URL for 1-click zero-cost downloads while preserving private codebase security.
  • Added SSL certificate verification context fallback to prevent certificate errors on clean macOS Python installations.

item.title: Version 0.9.40
item.description:
What's New in 0.9.40:

  • Direct GitHub Release model streaming with precise progress tracking and Hugging Face fallback.
  • Tuned audio VAD overlap (360ms) and capped soft gain multiplier (2.0x) to eliminate boundary repetitions and noise amplification.
  • Scenario-agnostic neutral prompt conditioning and unified single-pass master number normalization.
